decisions.decision: Committee to contact Paul Watts again at the beginning of next year regarding Shriners parade coordination
decisions.quote: we should contact him again at the beginning of next year.

decisions.decision: Pete and Debbie Lincoln to cover expenses for the Shriners parade
decisions.quote: pete and debbie lincoln will cover expenses.

decisions.decision: Caesar Nuzzolo to investigate online payment and donation methods through the Town
decisions.quote: caesar will check on how donations can be made through the town.

decisions.decision: Chris Sullivan to create a QR code for the Town Meeting presentation
decisions.quote: chris will work on a qr code.

decisions.decision: Debbie Lincoln to work with the Council on Aging on a Senior Calendar project
decisions.quote: debbie will work with the coa on a senior calendar in the line of "calendar girls."

decisions.decision: Committee to present short presentation at Town Meeting with 5 slides and collect feedback on volunteers and desired events
decisions.quote: it was decided to have a short presentation at town meeting (5 slides or so) and also collect feedback for volunteers and what people want to have for events.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parade coordination cost increased from initial $10,000 estimate to $12,000, with projection to $15,000 by 2028; no payment required until day of parade
budget_items.quote: the price has now risen from $10,000 to $12,000 and will likely be $15,000 by 2028. pete and debbie lincoln will cover expenses. pete li

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committee voted to sell commemorative 300th flower as fundraiser with minimum donation amount, to be available at Town Meeting and town events
budget_items.quote: it was voted to be sold at the town meeting for a minimum donation of $5.00, and also to have available at all town events

topics.resolution: Follow-up planned; contact Paul Watts again at beginning of year; costs noted escalating to projected $15,000 by 2028
topics.quote: paul watts, who will be our point person for the shriners for the parade. we are on their calendar for 9/10/28.

topics.resolution: Ongoing committee member collection from multiple locations
topics.quote: maura lizek has a lunenburg, vermont rock for the cairn, and is working on one from germany. nancy beach has nova scotia contacts.

topics.resolution: Approved for $5.00 minimum donation sales at Town Meeting and town events
topics.quote: it was voted to be sold at the town meeting for a minimum donation of $5.00, and also to have available at all town events

topics.resolution: Assigned to Caesar Nuzzolo to investigate options through the Town
topics.quote: can we add applepay and other forms of credit pay so folks don't have to use cash? caesar will check on how donations can be made through the town.

topics.resolution: Discussion and further inquiry on feasibility and cost of fireworks at midnight
topics.quote: first knight pyrotechnics were discussed. is there a company willing to do ﬁreworks at midnight for only 5 or 10 minutes?

topics.resolution: Approved to present 5 slides and collect feedback on volunteers and desired events
topics.quote: it was decided to have a short presentation at town meeting (5 slides or so) and also collect feedback for volunteers and what people want to have for events.
